signerlabs-shipswift-add-component.description: Add a SwiftUI component from ShipSwift. Use when the user says "add component", "add a view", "add X view", "I need a chart", "add animation", or wants a specific UI element.

signerlabs-shipswift-build-feature.description: Build an iOS feature using ShipSwift components. Use when the user says "build", "create", "add a feature", or describes an iOS feature they want to implement.

signerlabs-shipswift-explore-skills.description: Explore and browse available ShipSwift components. Use when the user says "explore", "browse", "show skills", "list components", "what's available", or wants to discover what ShipSwift offers.
